name: paralyzing breath
desc:
**Paralyzing Breath.** The [[lookup @details.type.config.label lowercase]]{monster} exhales paralyzing gas in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a  DC 20 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
